[Sir](../persons.html#1652)
I should be very glad of the establishment of the copy right system with [America ](../others.html#172)but I should like to have more information before joining the [Company of Authors](../others.html#44).

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: The letter evidently relates to the foundation of the Society of Authors in 1884; Besant was the prime mover in the organisation but the letter may have been addressed to a colleague.
